design: Retrospective descriptive audit; not preregistered hypothesis testing.
unit: Python Unicode code point, without Unicode normalization
rate: distance / max(len(source), 1); directional and potentially greater than one
acceptance: Every candidate distance equals an independent C++ Levenshtein implementation; both implementations also equal exhaustive edit-graph distances on all 225 ordered short binary-Unicode pairs.
seed_reason: Deterministic complete enumeration; no sampling or model inference.
